title: Worktree Agent Pulse
user: Solo developers and tiny teams running several CLI coding agents in Git worktrees who need a native overview of activity, blocked prompts and branch safety without switching terminal tabs.
smallest_useful_product: Cross-platform tray/desktop app that discovers Git worktrees, tails opt-in agent status adapters, shows dirty/ahead/blocked state, and opens the exact terminal/worktree.
success_measure: A five-worktree pilot finds a blocked agent or uncommitted branch from the board in under 10 seconds in 90% of prompted trials.
constraints: Opt-in adapters only; avoid capture of prompt/output content; protect repository paths; use Git read operations unless user triggers an action.
summary: See blocked agents and worktrees that need attention in one local board.
